snippet.title: Landing a 737 at Oberpfaffenhofen | Oleoflight
snippet.description:
First video on the channel, so let’s start with something a bit unusual: a 737 landing at Oberpfaffenhofen (EDMO), the special airport just southwest of Munich.
Everything you see here runs in a web browser. There’s nothing to download or install. That’s Oleoflight, the flight simulator we’ve been building.
Try it yourself: https://oleoflight.com
More flights, airports and updates on the sim are coming, so subscribe if you want to follow along. If there’s an airport or aircraft you’d like to see next, leave it in the comments.
#flightsimulator #boeing737 #oberpfaffenhofen #EDMO #aviation
